# ActionButtonFix

Separate actions for single and double click on the Action Button. Long press stays as Apple set it, and the Silent / hold pill no longer shows on a click.

## Actions

- **Control**: any Control Center control, picked in Apple's sheet (iOS 18+)
- **Accessibility**: Zoom, Magnifier, VoiceOver and the rest of Apple's list
- **Shortcut**: runs without opening Shortcuts, like Apple's button does
- **Siri**
- **Voice Memo**: start and stop a recording, also locked or with the screen off
- **Camera**: front or back, any mode, optional auto record. Works from the Lock Screen
- **Screen Recording**: same as Control Center's, countdown included
- **Control Center** (iOS 17): Dark Mode, Low Power, Rotation Lock, Quick Note, Timer and more
- **Flashlight**: four brightness levels. Volume buttons adjust it while it's on
- **Screenshot**: stock flow, works with Prism and Snapper 3
- **Media**: play/pause, next, previous
- **App**: any app. From the Lock Screen it asks for Face ID first
- **Stock Action**: the long press action, on a click
- **None**: click off. With double click on None, single click fires instantly

## When it runs

- **By Situation**: other actions on the Lock Screen and in apps you choose
- **While Media Plays**: media controls while something is playing
- **Condition (beta)**: another action while charging, on Wi-Fi, with headphones, while music plays or in a time range

Each click has its own haptic switch. A fresh install starts off, both clicks on None.

## Requirements

- iPhone with an Action Button, iOS 17 or later
- RootHide or rootless
- AltList (opa334's repo) and PreferenceLoader

- **By Situation**: own actions on the Lock Screen and in apps you choose.
- **Condition (beta)**: a different action while charging, on Wi-Fi, with headphones, while music plays or in a time range.
- App action on the Lock Screen asks for Face ID / passcode, then opens the app.
- Low Power Mode and Dark Mode fixed.
- New strings in 12 languages.

- iOS 27 support.
- Previous / Next work like Control Center on every iOS version.
- **Quick Note** opens the stock sheet.
- The Control Center module list follows your Control Center.
- iOS 18+: the Control action replaces the Control Center action.

- **While Media Plays** — play/pause, next, previous while media is playing.
- Volume buttons change flashlight brightness while it is on.

- **Control action** — any Control Center control (iOS 18+).
- **Accessibility action** — Zoom, Magnifier, VoiceOver and more.
- iOS 26: Screen Recording and Control Center work.

- **Shortcut action** — runs a shortcut like Apple's Action Button, picked in Apple's own sheet.
- **Siri action** — opens Siri like holding the side button.
- New settings look: an icon for every action; the selected one is colored and checked.

### New

**Voice Memo action** — starts and stops a recording, also on the Lock Screen and with the screen off. The start/stop sound can be turned off.

### Fixed

- Settings not saved on some installs
- Groundwork for iOS 18 and later

### New

**Media action** — play/pause, next track, previous track.

**Flashlight brightness** — Low, Medium, High, Maximum.

### Changes

- The Screenshot action now triggers screenshot tweaks such as Prism and Snapper 3
- Settings reorganized: each action's options sit in its own section

### Fixed

- The Camera action on iOS 17.3 — a click set to Camera ran the long-press action from iOS Settings instead of opening the camera

### New

**Control Center action** — runs one module per click: Dark Mode, Rotation Lock, Silent Mode, Low Power Mode, QR Code Reader, Magnifier, Voice Memos, Quick Note, Stopwatch, Timer, Alarm, Calculator, Wallet.

**None** — turns a click off. With double click set to None, the single click fires instantly, with no wait.

**Contact** — a row in Settings opens an email with the subject filled in.

### Changes

- On a fresh install the tweak is off and both clicks are None; camera defaults to the back camera, photo mode
- Settings storage renamed — **existing settings reset once on this update**; later updates keep them

### New

**Screen Recording action** — starts and stops the recording. Same as Control Center's: 3-2-1 countdown, Dynamic Island view, saved to Photos. A recording started in Control Center stops with the button, and the other way round. The microphone follows the Control Center setting.

### New

**Camera action** — side (Back / Front) and mode (Video, Slo-Mo, Time-Lapse, Cinematic, Photo, Portrait), chosen separately.

**Per-click camera settings** — side, mode and auto-record are set separately for single and double click.

**Stop with the same click** — while recording, the same click stops it.

### Changes

- Auto-started recording uses the normal recording screen: the photo button stays available, and the shutter stops it with one press
- Video Recording and Camera merged into one **Camera** action; clicks already set to Camera keep opening the back camera in photo mode
- Camera and its options have their own section in Settings

### Fixed

- The shutter could stay half-recording after an auto-start, needing two presses to stop
- Opening the camera by hand no longer starts a recording on its own

### New

**Video Recording action** — opens the camera in video mode and starts recording. Works with the screen off and on the Lock Screen.

**Start Recording Automatically** switch — off opens the camera in video mode and leaves the recording to you.

**App action** — any installed app, per click, from a searchable list.

**Stock Action** — the long-press action from iOS Settings, on a click.

**Haptic feedback** — separate switches per click, on by default.

**12 languages** — Turkish, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic.

**Rootless package** — alongside RootHide.

### Changes

- Installs directly on RootHide, no extra tool
- More stable Camera action
- Smaller package

First public release.

- Screenshot uses the stock flow — flash, corner preview, tap to edit
- Screenshot does nothing while the screen is off, by design
- Camera opens properly from the Home Screen, with no session left running
- Flashlight stays in sync with Control Center
- New icon, tidied Settings page
